Name: Kedi's Tilesheets
Author: KediDili
TagLine: This is a mod for other mods to use it as a resource of tilesheets.
Description:
This is a mod for other mods to use it as a resource of tilesheets. I have converted my two recent furniture mods to map tilesheets so modders could use them in their maps too if they have wanted.

For users: Just install this mod and unzip it in your Mods folder.

For modders: Use the tilesheets in this mod just like they are vanilla tilesheets while mapping, just don't include them while releasing/updating your mod (As this will cause bugs) and don't forget to add this mod as a required dependency.
